# Magic Internet Frens

> Magic Internet Frens (MiFrens) is a collection of 2222 hand-crafted pixel
> wizards, knights, gnomes and degens — summoned fully on-chain — and the home of
> The Cauldron, an eternal, autonomous on-chain token machine. Website:
> https://mifrens.xyz · X/Twitter: https://x.com/magic0xfrens

## What it is
- **1111 genesis MiFrens**: fully on-chain pixel-art NFTs (wizards, kings, knights, gnomes, elves, apprentices, peasants). Each is unique and inscribed forever.
- **The Cauldron**: an eternal, autonomous token machine built on Uniswap v4. Each "iteration" token lives, is traded, and — when its 24h volume dies — is reborn as the next iteration chosen by MiFren-holder governance. It funds itself from its own swap fees. Governance has guarded break-glass paths for protocol-owned liquidity: immutable emergency admin, mandatory arm, deployment-specific delay, guardian veto, and a forced-open redemption exit. It cannot touch assets held in user wallets.
- **Genesis dividend**: holders of the 1111 genesis MiFrens earn a perpetual share of every iteration's trading fees. Holders "cast the spell" to activate a fren's fee-earning.
- **Genesis redemption floor**: each genesis fren has a live floor denominated in whatever iteration token is currently running, designed to ratchet UP (recycle at floor → NFT to treasury → resold at 2× → the reserve grows → the floor rises for everyone). Claimable while the token trades below its per-iteration reserve ceiling.
- **The token model**: each iteration's token is fixed-supply (777,000,000), non-mintable, and non-freezable. Holders migrate 1:1 into new iterations by burning the old token. Migration is optional.
- **The Crystal Cauldron (gacha game)**: trading volume banks credit (buys weighted 1.5×, sells 0.5×), which is spent to commit CRYSTALS. A crystal is a ticket inside the hook, not a tradeable token. Each is rolled later from its commit block's hash. Normal resolve activity pins that seed beyond the EVM's 256-block horizon; an untouched expired batch gets one re-anchor, then forfeits non-pity rolls on a second expiry. A win mints a real ERC-721 that arrives UNREVEALED (a shared placeholder, tradeable in that state); reveal() then rolls rarity and flips to on-chain art. Odds scale up to 90%, and a pity counter guarantees a win after 8 consecutive genuine misses.
- **Perps**: hook-native leveraged longs and shorts on the live token with real price impact — every open, close and liquidation is an actual Uniswap v4 swap. No external oracle; liquidation marks use the engine's own on-chain TWAP.

## Key facts
- Collection size: 2222 total (1111 genesis frens minted at launch + 1111 forged via trading volume in The Cauldron)
- Fully on-chain art (pixel sprites, deterministic per token)
- Canonical live manifest: Ethereum Sepolia. Production deployment path: Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663), an Arbitrum Nitro/Orbit L2 with ETH as the native gas token
- Swap fee: 3% default (capped at 10%), taken in the pool's quote asset on both legs; Uniswap LP fee tier is 0. Split from the top: 0.5% to the iteration's proposer, 15% to the genesis dividend, then the collection floor buyback and the relaunch reserve
- Only genesis ids 1..1111 vote. Forged frens and Liquidatoor badges do not create voting units or inflate quorum. The Robinhood launch gate requires a 7-fren per-wallet genesis cap.
- Shipped launch mode is atomic green-candle seeding. Progressive-seeder contracts are wired, but `SEED_BASE_WAD = 1e18` makes streaming dormant.
- Treasury quote rotation is genesis-governed, allowlisted, sliced and permissionless within an approved envelope; rotated legs remain tracked and are recovered at rebirth.
- Important open limitations: 6-decimal quotes cannot realistically reach the default live-buyback threshold; an ETH donation can re-arm the deprecated per-brew vault and desynchronize its ledger floor; a partially rebooked short loses future funding/penalty/bounty accounting; rarity reveal is not seed-pinned and can fall back to Common after two expired 256-block windows. See the full file for exact mechanics and mitigations.
- Iteration #1 brew: "Gnomeland" ($GNOME)
- Contract addresses are NOT listed here on purpose: they rotate every round, and per-iteration addresses (token, collection, pool id) rotate at every rebirth. Read them live from the registry (currentToken, generationCollection, generationPoolId) or from the docs page, which renders them live.
- Brand voice: playful, magical, "gm fren", "wagmi", wizard/arcane theme
- Accent color: Robinhood lime (#d5fd51) on wizard purple (#2A1F54)

holders earn fees forever. gm.
